statements.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI).—The agreement provides no less than the fiscal year 2023 enacted level for NIST's ongoing AI research and measurement science efforts and to execute its responsibilities pursuant to Executive Order 14110, ``Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence.'' Within the funds provided, up to $10,000,000 is available for the establishment of a U.S. AI Safety Institute.
statements.context: Explanatory statement submitted by the Chair of the Senate Committee on Appropriations regarding the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2024.

statements.text: Our nuclear innovation is a nation that began with the Manhattan Project, and the next Manhattan Project is clearly AI (Artificial Intelligence).
statements.context: Senate Energy and Water Development Appropriations Subcommittee hearing on the DOE FY 2026 budget request, featuring testimony from Secretary of Energy Christopher Wright.

statements.text: No way should an algorithm decide if seniors should get the care they need.
statements.context: Senate floor speech by Senator Patty Murray introducing a resolution of congressional disapproval to overturn a CMS pilot program (WISeR Model) that uses AI for Medicare prior authorization.
